independent_review_reason: CODEOWNER assigned Grok Build to challenge the existing change.

escalation_record.unresolved_gap: The CODEOWNER wants independent challenge of the existing change before merge.
escalation_record.deterministic_tooling_assessment: Portable tests and ShellCheck pass; they do not replace independent review.
escalation_record.cursor_limit: Cursor already implemented and tested the change; independent review must not re-implement it.
escalation_record.missing_capability: Independent challenge/review of the existing pull request.
escalation_record.scope: Inspect only the existing Cursor change; do not re-implement routine work or approve the merge.
escalation_record.completion_criterion: Record advisory independent-review findings or conclude that the available evidence is insufficient.
escalation_record.stop_condition: Stop when the gap is closed, deterministic evidence answers it, Grok is unavailable, or tests contradict the reviewer.

context.notes: Reuse the existing Cursor analysis, PR discussion, and CI logs.
